verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs describe Queries that let users define criteria over structured properties/Types and render results as Views (tables, boards, lists), backed by custom Types/properties and composable database blocks (kanban, calendar) per GitHub description. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of live view rendering (tables/boards/lists) beyond docs, and no community evidence confirming query/view robustness at scale (one community comment calls graph view unusable with hundreds of objects, though that's a different feature).
